p0.title: 3D Rose Blazer Mini Dress
p0.descriptionHtml:
A black blazer dress with puffed shoulders and red 3D roses on long green stems climbing the front.

  • Polyester suiting with a smooth, structured finish
  • Fitted waist, notch lapels, single-breasted buttons, flap pockets
  • Long sleeves, mini length (about 31–32 in)

Sizes S–XL · Bust 34–39 in

p1.title: Notch Lapel Faux Suede Blazer
p1.descriptionHtml:
A relaxed faux suede blazer with notch lapels and a yoke seam across the chest, easy over a turtleneck and jeans.

  • Polyester faux suede, smooth satin-look lining
  • Loose fit, three-button front, flap hip pockets
  • Long sleeves, hip length (about 25–26 in)

Sizes S–L · Bust 40–43 in

p2.title: Off-Shoulder Open Back Maxi Dress
p2.descriptionHtml:
A floor-length column dress with a folded off-shoulder band and a deep scoop open back.

  • Soft, stretchy polyester jersey with a matte finish
  • Close, body-skimming fit, folded band across the shoulders
  • Maxi length (about 50–52 in from the band)

Sizes S–L · Bust 34–37 in

p3.title: Snap Collar Faux Leather Jacket
p3.descriptionHtml:
A fitted faux leather moto-style jacket with a snap-tab stand collar and shaped seams through the waist.

  • Smooth PU faux leather with a soft sheen
  • Center zip, zip chest pocket, zip side pockets
  • Long sleeves, hip length (about 21–23 in)

Sizes S–XL · Bust 37–43 in

p4.title: Tiered Stripe Sleeveless Swing Dress
p4.descriptionHtml:
A loose tiered swing dress in crisp white-and-color stripes with a ruffled hem, an easy summer dress with sandals.

  • Lightweight polyester and spandex blend
  • Loose fit, scoop neck, sleeveless, pullover
  • Three tiers, knee length (about 37–38 in)

Sizes S–XL · Bust 37–43 in

p5.title: Mock Neck Side-Pleat Mini Dress
p5.descriptionHtml:
A sleek sleeveless mini with a high mock neck and sculpted pleats that flare out from metal ring details at each hip.

  • Polyester with a smooth matte finish
  • Fitted bodice, princess seams, metal ring hardware
  • Sleeveless, above-knee length (about 35–36 in)

Sizes S–XL · Bust 34–39 in

p6.title: Floral Satin Blazer Mini Set
p6.descriptionHtml:
A matching set of a cropped floral blazer and a high-waist mini with a front slit, printed in soft pink and mint peonies.

  • Polyester satin with a soft sheen, lined blazer
  • Cropped double-breasted blazer (about 17–18 in), gold-tone buttons
  • High-waist skort-style mini (about 14 in), front slit

Sizes S–L · Bust 38–41 in · Waist 25–28 in

p7.title: Cowl Neck Satin Maxi Dress
p7.descriptionHtml:
A glossy satin maxi with a draped cowl neckline, a low open back and a high side slit.

  • Satin-finish fabric with a high sheen
  • Close fit, adjustable spaghetti straps, side zip, elastic back
  • Floor-length maxi (about 55–56 in), thigh-high slit

Sizes S–L · Bust 30–33 in
